descriptionChirho: A place of imprisonment or confinement where prisoners are held under restraint. Used of literal prisons and dungeons in Kings, Chronicles, Jeremiah, and Isaiah. The noun covers both singular (the prison, a dungeon) and plural (prisons) usages, as well as suffixed forms (his prison), all referring to the same concrete concept of a place of incarceration or the state of being confined. Multilingual glosses consistently render this as prison/jail across Arabic (السجن), German (prison), Korean (감옥), Spanish (carcel/prision), and Hindi (बंदीखाने/कारागार).
